## Preparation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Install and Load R packages"}
#install.packages("sfdep")

pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, sfdep, tmap)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Import data"}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Join data"}
hunan_GDPPC <- left_join(hunan, hunan2012) %>% 
  select(1:4, 7, 15)
```
:::


## Chloropleth map to show the distribution of GDPPC of Hunan Province


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(hunan_GDPPC) +
  tm_fill("GDPPC", 
          style = "quantile", 
          palette = "Blues",
          title = "GDPPC") +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Distribution of GDP per capita by county, Hunan Province",
            main.title.position = "center",
            main.title.size = 1.2,
            legend.height = 0.45, 
            legend.width = 0.35,
            frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scale_bar() +
  tm_grid(alpha =0.2)
```

## Global Measures of Spatial Association

### Deriving Queen's contiguity weights: sfdep methods


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_q <- hunan_GDPPC %>%
  mutate(nb = st_contiguity(geometry),
         wt = st_weights(nb,
                         style = "W"),
         .before = 1) 

wm_q
```

### Computing Global Moran' I test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
moranI <- global_moran(wm_q$GDPPC,
                       wm_q$nb,
                       wm_q$wt)
glimpse(moranI)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
List of 2
 $ I: num 0.301
 $ K: num 7.64
```


:::
:::


### Performing Global Moran'I permutation test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Set seed for the simulation"}
set.seed(1234)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
global_moran_perm(wm_q$GDPPC,
                       wm_q$nb,
                       wm_q$wt,
                  nsim = 99)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

```

## Hot Spot and Cold Spot Area Analysis (HCSA)

Deriving special weight matrix based on distances.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_idw <- hunan_GDPPC %>%
  mutate(nb = include_self(
    st_contiguity(geometry)),
    wts = st_inverse_distance(nb, 
                              geometry, 
                              scale = 1,
                              alpha = 1),
         .before = 1)
```
:::


Compute local Gi\* statistics.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HCSA <- wm_idw %>% 
  mutate(local_Gi = local_gstar_perm(
    GDPPC, nb, wts, nsim = 99),
         .before = 1) %>%
  unnest(local_Gi)
HCSA
```

### Visualising Gi\*


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_fill("gi_star") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_view(set.zoom.limits = c(6,8))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


### Visualising p-value of HCSA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_fill("p_sim") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


### Visualising local HCSA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
map1 <- tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_fill("gi_star") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_view(set.zoom.limits = c(6,8)) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Gi* of GDPPC",
            main.title.size = 0.8)

map2 <- tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_fill("p_value",
          breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
              labels = c("0.001", "0.01", "0.05", "Not sig")) + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "p-value of Gi*",
            main.title.size = 0.8)

tmap_arrange(map1, map2, ncol = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


### Visualising hot spot and cold spot areas


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HCSA_sig <- HCSA  %>%
  filter(p_sim < 0.05)
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
tm_shape(HCSA_sig) +
  tm_fill("cluster") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.4)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Figure above reveals that there is one hot spot area and two cold spot areas. Interestingly, the hot spot areas coincide with the High-high cluster identifies by using local Moran's I method in the earlier sub-section.
